title: Create teacher editor UI
goal: Build the teacher editor UI for title, instructions, questions, answers, and live preview updates.
context: The worksheet should always be editable before export. Do not treat generated output as sacred.
acceptance: Teacher can edit title and instructions
Teacher can edit question prompt and expected answer
Teacher can add, duplicate, and delete questions
E2E or component test covers the edit flow
notes: Keep UI practical and dense. Do not add accounts or collaboration.
